t08-glyph-f1-dry-bank.subject: glyph-check--pond-bank-tree--inashiro
t08-glyph-f1-dry-bank.command: python3 <scratchpad>/measure_bank.py inashiro (point-in-polygon of each pond_bank_trees trunk against every marshes poly)
t08-glyph-f1-dry-bank.method: the bank's ellipse is a no-build block the toe marsh subtracts (D61b)

value.note: 0 of 30 trunks in any marsh; the toe marsh left on the bank is the 32-gon's chords, about 350 sq ft along 1,300 ft of bank

t08-glyph-f2-jitter.subject: glyph-check--pond-bank-tree--inashiro
t08-glyph-f2-jitter.quantity: the trunks' radial spread across the bank
t08-glyph-f2-jitter.command: each trunk's normalized radius against the ring at the fringe plus 6 ft
t08-glyph-f2-jitter.method: seats jittered across the bank by position as well as along it (D61b)

value.note: the trunks spread over the bank's 6 ft play, so they no longer stand on one ellipse
